scientific_integrity: Analytic finite-graph theorem for a specified symmetric stochastic Allee model; proof uses Laplacian energy decay, first-refresh competition, and an explicit lower-probability event. Exact rational checker verifies selected algebraic identities but does not substitute for the unrestricted proof.
scientific_limitations: Common threshold and symmetric edge mixing only; noncritical initial mean; graph size fixed in the strong-dispersal limit. Error constant is not sharp, only the inverse-rate exponent. The comparison with general averaging literature is not exhaustive.
title: A topology-explicit inverse-dispersal law for stochastic Allee fixation
